cases.name: etaf-pi-test-help-stays-in-client
cases.purpose: Native help keys, the public command and /help share a searchable in-buffer modal, preserve the draft and restore focus after layered Escape.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-acknowledgement-preserves-active-edit
cases.purpose: A delayed prompt acceptance leaves an active in-place editing session and its text untouched.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-stream-and-framing
cases.purpose: Fragmented UTF-8 and CRLF records reconstruct a captured real stream.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-correlation-and-timeout
cases.purpose: Out-of-order replies correlate and missing replies time out without retries.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-failure-lifecycle
cases.purpose: Malformed output and unexpected exit terminate pending requests visibly.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-authoritative-end-and-retry
cases.purpose: Final messages replace indexed deltas and retries do not settle prematurely.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-dialog-and-shutdown
cases.purpose: Dialog ids and false responses survive transport; close is idempotent.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-native-client-workflow
cases.purpose: The native client sends, switches settings, cancels dialogs, resumes and closes.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-composer-draft-and-send
cases.purpose: The in-layout composer keeps a cancelled draft and clears the acknowledged text.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-draft-failure-and-concurrent-edit
cases.purpose: Failed sends and edits made before acknowledgement retain their input.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-composer-keys-and-session-switch-guard
cases.purpose: Shift+Enter adds a line, Enter sends, and pending session changes reject sends.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-reopen-and-switch-owned-panes
cases.purpose: Reopening from input reuses panes and switching clients preserves the prior hidden session without nested layouts.

cases.name: etaf-pi-test-reentrant-listener-preserves-wire-order
cases.purpose: Callbacks yielding for subprocess output cannot reorder JSONL events and responses.
